programme.title: 7 Up: The Story
programme.desc: In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about fourteen seven-year-olds. It became the longest running documentary series ever. Those children are now seventy. 7 Up set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system - that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. The production team had three weeks to find them. They went to some of the poorest parts of the country and some of the most privileged, and came back with ten boys and four girls. The series became one of British television's most remarkable social experiments, the cameras dipping into their lives every seven years. Children from different parts of the class system who have now become friends. Overseas troops trained here too, including Americans, Czechs and Norwegians. They came here to be put through their paces in the highland glens, rivers and mountains.

programme.title: 7 Up: The Story
programme.desc: In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about fourteen seven-year-olds. It became the longest running documentary series ever. Those children are now seventy. 7 Up set out to prove that Britain was divided by the class system - that these children's futures had been decided by the street they were born on. The production team had three weeks to find them. They went to some of the poorest parts of the country and some of the most privileged, and came back with ten boys and four girls. The series became one of British television's most remarkable social experiments, the cameras dipping into their lives every seven years. Children from different parts of the class system who have now become friends. This special programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what they hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.

programme.title: Old Henry

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Set to his most beloved songs is the epic musical story of Elton John, from his breakthrough years in the 1970s to his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar and pop icon.

programme.title: Catch Me if You Can
programme.desc: Based on a true-crime story about teenage con man Frank Abagnale Jr, who cashed fake cheques worth over $2.5 million while disguised as a pilot, a doctor and a lawyer, all the while chased by an FBI agent who is determined to catch him.

Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell, an ageing lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: Promising Young Woman
programme.desc: Nothing in Cassie's life is what it appears to be, she's wickedly smart, tantalisingly cunning, and she's living a secret double life by night. Now, an unexpected encounter is about to give Cassie a chance to right the wrongs from the past.

programme.title: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: Louis Bloom finds himself falling head first in to the shady world of crime journalism. He quickly develops a taste for the profession and discovers that he has got both the business acumen and a strong enough stomach to fend off his rivals.

programme.title: Strange Darling
programme.desc: Nothing is what it seems when a twisted one-night stand spirals into a serial killer's vicious murder spree.

programme.title: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A desperate and crazed man, with the help of an accomplice, takes a local Brooklyn bank hostage with plans to rob it in order to pay for his lover's sex-change operation.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis, quickly christened 'Joker' by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant, and pudgy Private Lawrence, nicknamed 'Gomer Pyle', as they endure the rigours of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering, and eventually participating in, the Battle of Hue.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Jason Bourne is living in India when he is framed by Russian agent Kirill for the theft of millions from the CIA. Kirill begins to pursue Bourne, intending to assassinate him, but while Bourne and his girlfriend, Marie, are on the run, a shot meant for him kills her instead. Vowing revenge, Bourne sets out to prove his innocence and bring the culprits to justice, but he has to evade CIA head Pamela Landry, who is convinced he is guilty.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: A former CIA assassin continues his quest to fill in memory gaps. When a 'Guardian' reporter stumbles onto his trail, the man spies his chance to blow the Blackbriar black-ops brigade wide open. With some very powerful people intent on keeping their skeletons buried, he is in more danger than ever before, as his former paymasters send a series of elite killers after their reformed ex-colleague.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Agent Aaron Cross must use his genetically-enhanced skills to finish what Jason Bourne started in this action-packed hit that takes the Bourne series to explosive new levels.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: It's been ten years since Jason Bourne walked away from the agency that trained him to become a deadly weapon. Hoping to draw him out of the shadows, CIA director Robert Dewey assigns hacker and counterinsurgency expert Heather Lee to find him. Lee suspects that former operative Nicky Parsons is also looking for him. As she begins tracking the duo, Bourne finds himself back in action battling a sinister network that utilizes terror and technology to maintain unchecked power.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: An amnesiac is rescued at sea by the crew of an Italian fishing boat. Nearly dead, he carries nothing but the bullets in his back and the bank account number embedded in his hip. programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Mahoney and friends have graduated from the Police Academy and are issued with their first assignments. As before, their cheerfulness and devotion to duty outweighs any shortcomings, but are they ready to do battle with a band of graffiti daubing terrorists?

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Bart, a black railroad worker is appointed sheriff of a town marked for destruction by Hedley Lamarr, a scheming politician. As Lamarr tries to drive out the town's residents, Bart decides to stand in his way.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.

programme.title: Uncle Buck
programme.desc: A bungling bachelor becomes a last-minute babysitter. Buck's brother's three children are foisted on him when the parents are called away from home indefinitely. Although he seems to be an unsuitable guardian, Buck turns out to have an unexpected knack for parenting, but he must work hard to prove himself, especially when he needs to save his eldest niece from her unsavoury boyfriend.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: A womanising New York marketing man meets his match in his new boss. After initially spurning his advances, she ultimately gives him a taste of his own medicine.

programme.desc: Tongue-in-cheek tale about a high-speed car chase across America involving a sheriff and a bootlegger with crash stunts galore. programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: Chicago teen Ren and his family move to the small Midwestern town of Bomont, where rock music has been banned.

programme.title: Chaplin
programme.desc: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charlie Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972.

programme.title: Cool Hand Luke
programme.desc: When petty criminal Luke Jackson is sentenced to two years in a Florida prison farm, he doesn't play by the rules of either the sadistic warden or the yard's resident heavy, Dragline, who ends up admiring the new guy's unbreakable will. Luke's bravado, even in the face of repeated stints in the prison's dreaded solitary confinement cell, 'the box' makes him a rebel hero to his fellow convicts and a thorn in the side of the prison officers.

programme.title: Tommy
programme.desc: Ken Russell's flamboyant treatment of the Who's rock opera about a deaf, dumb and blind boy who develops an extraordinary ability at pinball. Under his sinister stepfather's influence, he achieves fame and a cult following, but his almost messianic status also spells the beginning of his destruction.

programme.title: The Breakfast Club
programme.desc: Five school kids - an athlete, a spoiled rich kid, a brainy nerd, an introverted loner and a rebellious punk - are brought together on a day-long detention where they break the rules, bare their souls and find they have more in common than just attending the same high school.

programme.title: GOAT
programme.desc: A small goat named Will gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball -- a high-intensity, full-contact sport that's dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

programme.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit 2
programme.desc: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

programme.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
programme.desc: A young farmhand gets swept into the realm of legend when he must defend his land from a seemingly unstoppable force of giant warriors.

programme.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
programme.desc: After the three young Baudelaire siblings are left orphaned by a fire in their mansion, they are carted off to live with their distant relative, Count Olaf. Unfortunately, Olaf is a cruel, scheming man only after the inheritance that the eldest Baudelaire, Violet, is set to receive. The children escape and find shelter with their quirky Uncle Monty and, subsequently, their phobic Aunt Josephine, but Olaf is never far behind.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
programme.desc: When a single mother and her two children move to a new town, they soon discover that they have a connection to the original Ghostbusters and their grandfather's secret legacy.

programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
programme.desc: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

programme.title: GOAT
programme.desc: A small goat named Will gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball -- a high-intensity, full-contact sport that's dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Spoiled by their upbringing and with no idea of what wildlife is really like, Alex the lion, Marty the zebra, Gloria the hippo and hypochondriac giraffe Melman swap New York's Central Park Zoo for Madagascar.

programme.title: The Pirates! In an Adventure With Scientists
programme.desc: An inept swashbuckler decides to make an attempt to win the Pirate of the Year Award, and beat his rivals Black Bellamy and Cutlass Liz in a race to plunder the most booty. His journey takes him to Victorian London where the Pirate Captain must choose between winning Pirate of the Year, or helping his crew.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. Their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.

programme.title: GOAT
programme.desc: A small goat named Will gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball -- a high-intensity, full-contact sport that's dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
programme.desc: A boy and his dragon stumble across a secret ice cave, which is home to hundreds of dragons and a mysterious being known as the Dragon Rider. The duo must work together to preserve a peaceful future for humans and dragons.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

programme.title: The Witches
programme.desc: Creepy fairy tale following the fortunes of a young orphan who becomes embroiled in a supernatural adventure. Brought up on his kindly grandmother's scary stories about witches, he stumbles on a real coven while on holiday. Overhearing their plans to capture all the children in Britain, he sets out to stop them, remaining undeterred throughout - even when he has been turned into a mouse.

programme.desc: 16 December 1971 was the day when India won the war against Pakistan and was able to liberate Bangladesh from Pakistan's rule. programme.title: South Pacific
programme.desc: Looking at the remote South Pacific islands. Their extraordinary isolation has created some of the most curious, surprising and precarious examples of life found anywhere on Earth, from giant crabs that tear open coconuts to flesh-eating caterpillars that impale their prey on dagger-like claws. Human culture is different, too.

programme.title: Flog It!

Among them are rare medals that once belonged to an early aviator and puppets that look like the Swedish band ABBA. Plus, Paul delves into the history of seaside entertainment.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Jennie Bond, James Bye, Kadeena Cox and Aurie Styla take on a series of quiz rounds selected by quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: For 11 months of the year, the city of La Vega is well off the tourist track. But each February, it bursts into life. Over the course of four weekends, it's loud, hot and colourful as visitors from all over the world arrive to join in the famous street carnivals.

programme.title: Grand Tours of Scotland's Lochs

The voyages of the South Pacific's first people, the Polynesians, were no less remarkable. Their journeys were some of the greatest ever undertaken.
